related_box_thumbnail_base.classification_correction: Phase-1 incorrectly grouped this bundle with the selector. Decomp/runtime tracing shows member 70 is the six-box thumbnail base updated from box contents, not the wallpaper selector.

decomp_verification.behavior: ov14_021F4380 creates four member-74 selector sprites 46 px apart; ov14_021F462C reloads/recolors the member-74 graphics when the wallpaper group changes. ov14_021F4958 instead uses member 70 to build box-content thumbnails.

pixel_rule: The committed PNGs are byte-for-byte copies of the user-preserved HeartGold PC Box extraction. No redraw, crop, resampling, recoloring, or synthetic pixels.
status: phase 2 complete: authentic HGSS member-74 wallpaper selector swatches are wired live; legacy list cursor/scroll-arrow equivalents intentionally retained for phase 3
next: Remove the remaining legacy wallpaper-selector equivalents only: the standard ListMenu cursor/scroll-arrow presentation, replacing navigation feedback with the now-live HGSS selector controls without changing wallpaper selection behavior.

export.pixel_rule: Exact member-74 NCER composition at 1:1 pixel scale. Source 8bpp pixels use only transparent index 0 and placeholder index 30; the GBA export losslessly compacts that binary mask to 4bpp. No visible pixel is redrawn, resampled, or moved.

live_integration.renderer: four GBA OBJ sprites using the verified HGSS NCER 76 cell
live_integration.layout: four wallpaper choices per page, six pages, matching the native HGSS 24-wallpaper grouping
live_integration.gba_adaptation: Each 24x24 authentic cell is transparent-padded to a 32x32 hardware OBJ. Four copies share one 4bpp palette; the binary placeholder mask is remapped to palette entries 1-4 without altering visible geometry.
live_integration.normal_color_mapping: Wallpaper IDs 0-15 use exact NCLR 75 colors 16-31, matching ov14_021F46B0's native normal-wallpaper replacement indices.
live_integration.special_color_mapping: Wallpaper IDs 16-23 use the remaining first eight authentic NCLR 75 colors as a compact GBA continuation; no synthetic colors are introduced.
